commands.name: certificates
enrol

options.name: --holder
options.description: Whose certificate this is, by e-mail. Omitted  enrols it for the caller.

options.name: --label
options.description: What the holder calls this key: "YubiKey  5C", "work laptop".

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The certificate to enrol — PEM (.pem/.crt) or DER (.cer/.der). A chain is accepted.

commands.description: Enrol one certificate, for a named holder or the  caller.

commands.name: import

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change and send nothing.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

arguments.name: manifest
arguments.description: The CA's manifest: what it issued, and what  it revoked.

commands.description: Enrol and revoke in bulk from a CA manifest. Safe to  re-run.

commands.name: list

options.name: --holder
options.description: Only this holder's, by e-mail. Omitted lists  the whole tenant's (an administrator's view).

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: Report what is enrolled, including what is no longer  usable and why.

commands.name: revoke

options.name: --on
options.description: The revocation date (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to  today, UTC.

options.name: --serial
options.description: The certificate's serial — what a  certification authority names it by.

options.name: --thumbprint
options.description: The certificate's SHA-256 thumbprint, as the  listing reports it.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: Revoke one, by serial or thumbprint.
Reader certificates, for a tenant administrator.

commands.name: login

options.name: --no-export
options.description: Print only the confirmation, not the shell exports  (for a human, not for eval).

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: Sign in through the device grant and print the session as  shell exports.

commands.name: certificate

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.name: register

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The certificate file to register — PEM  (.pem/.crt) or DER (.cer/.der).

commands.description: Register a certificate from a file (the public  certificate only).

commands.name: show

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: Report the registered certificate, or that there  is none.
The certificate this user's content is enveloped  to.

commands.name: activate

options.name: --licence
options.description: The vendor-signed licence file to file and  activate.

options.name: --module
options.description: Activate only this module of the ones the licence  names. Default: every one this installation has.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name for the filed licence document. Default: a  name naming the modules and the expiry.

options.name: --parent
options.description: Id of the document (a repository or folder) to  file the licence in.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: File a vendor-signed licence and activate every module it names.

commands.name: rebuild

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

arguments.name: module
arguments.description: The module whose projection to rebuild, by id  — e.g. encryption.

arguments.name: projection
arguments.description: Which projection. Omitted rebuilds every  projection the module declares.

commands.description: Re-derive a module's read model from documents.  One projection, or all.

commands.name: create

options.name: --admin-email
options.description: Email of the tenant's first administrator.

options.name: --admin-name
options.description: Display name of that administrator.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: Platform-administrator client id  (client-credentials grant).

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Platform-administrator client secret. Prefer  SACONSOLE_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment.

options.name: --name
options.description: Tenant name.

options.name: --repository
options.description: Name of the tenant's first repository.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the installation, e.g.  https://archive.example.com. Defaults to $SACONSOLE_URL.

commands.description: Provision a tenant with its first administrator and  repository.

commands.name: whoami
